about_the_game:
Town Crazy – Demo

Dodge traffic. Dodge chickens. Just don’t crash.

Town Crazy is a time-constrained 2.5D top-down driving game made for speed-runners, chaos lovers, and casual drivers alike. In this demo, you’ll experience the first taste of the madness, a city filled with unpredictable traffic, panicked chickens, and deadly roadblocks. Try to survive it all… or just cruise through it.

  • 5 action-packed levels from the full game.

  • 2 unique cars, each with their own speed and handling.

  • Dynamic obstacles, challenges, and traffic to overcome.

  • Earn Stars, finish fast, earn 3 stars, or just cruise to the goal.

The full version of Town Crazy throws you into 30 levels of escalating city chaos, tighter roads, nastier traffic, weirder layouts, and way more suicidal chickens, so you'll have to earn your way deeper into the madness. Each level features one of 6 uniquely handling cars: some fast and twitchy, some slow and slippery, all equally determined to betray you at corners. You’ll compete for glory on a global leaderboard that tracks your total game clear time, but if you’re not in the mood to sweat, just switch to Free Roam and vibe in traffic like a menace with no consequences. With full controller support, tight physics, and a city that actively wants you gone, Town Crazy is a perfect pick for speedrunners, leaderboard addicts, casual chaos lovers, and anyone who’s ever braked too late and screamed quietly.

Let me know what you think!
Too easy? Too hard? Too many chickens?
Not enough chaos? Too much chaos?

Leave a comment or share your best time.
I’m a solo developer and your feedback helps shape the full release.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11/10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 /Intel Core i3-7100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 7620G / Nvidia GT 720
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Best played with controller.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11/10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2500X / Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 280 / Nvidia GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Best played with controller.

short_description: Drive 6 different cars through 30 tricky levels. Avoid obstacles, dodge traffic, find shortcuts and slip past chickens. Crash, restart, and master each run to beat the timer. Climb the leaderboard and prove you’re the best driver in town crazy.
